extension.summary: Yle Areena: catalog, live TV, search, radio and podcasts
Yle Areena: selaus, suorat, haku, radio ja podcastit
extension.description: Unofficial, visually rich Yle Areena client: browse the on-demand catalog by category, watch the live TV channels and live events, search, and listen to live radio and podcasts.
Epävirallinen Yle Areena -asiakas: selaa ohjelmistoa kategorioittain, katso suorat TV-kanavat ja tapahtumat, hae sisältöä sekä kuuntele radiota ja podcasteja.
extension.disclaimer: This add-on is not endorsed by Yle. Most content is viewable only in Finland.
Tämä ei ole Ylen virallinen lisäosa. Suurin osa sisällöstä näkyy vain Suomessa.
extension.news:
v1.0.3 (2026-06-11) - Live TV now/next EPG now shows program titles (was "?")
v1.0.2 (2026-06-11) - Fixed live TV now/next EPG times (were off by the timezone offset) - Fixed season number being dropped on the 2nd+ page of long seasons - Playback now trusts the resolved stream type over the menu hint - Hardened catalog/duration/cache parsing against odd API responses - Swedish episode tabs (Avsnitt/Klipp) now recognised
v1.0.1 (2026-06-11) - VOD starts at full quality immediately (new "Video-on-demand quality" setting, default Maximum; switch to Adaptive on slow connections)
v1.0.0 (2026-06-11) - Browse the full Areena catalog: front page, 12 categories, series/seasons/episodes - Live TV (TV1, TV2, Teema & Fem) with now/next EPG + live events - Search with history; live radio and podcasts - Rich artwork (posters, fanart) and metadata - Live TV plays via the Kodi core player (stall-free, 1080p50); InputStream Adaptive and FFmpeg Direct selectable in settings

extension.description: Personal Kodi repository serving the Yleplugin1 Yle Areena addon with automatic updates.
